title: Add Built‑in Request Logging Middleware with Configurable Formats
description: Provides automatic structured request logging for every incoming HTTP request, improving observability and debugging in production. The middleware supports customizable log formats (combined, dev, json) and optional request ID correlation, without adding external dependencies.
testCases: Logs a request using default "combined" format and verifies output contains method, url, status, and response time
Logs a request with json format and requestId enabled, asserting the JSON structure includes a unique requestId field
acceptance: When the logger middleware is enabled, each request produces a correctly formatted log entry according to the selected format; the logger can be toggled via app configuration and does not impact request latency beyond <5ms in benchmark tests.
reason: Enhanced observability is critical for production stability and rapid issue resolution; a zero‑dependency, configurable logger aligns with yantraverse's lightweight philosophy while filling a core operational gap.
